YOUTH 2000 CHRISTMAS RETREAT Calling all young people aged 16-35; a 3-day retreat run by young people from all over Ireland, from 11th-13th December, in Newbridge College, Co Kildare. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland St John's
